question: Should the summary lead with the base or the downside scenario?

output.summary: Downside breaks even, base and upside are positive per year. The one-time investment stays separate; cash flow and payback are not available.

claim.statement: Downside: 50 customers, €1,000,000 annual revenue, contribution after opex €0 per year (break-even).
Base: 100 customers, €2,000,000 annual revenue, contribution after opex €600,000 per year.
Upside: capped at 120 customers by capacity, €2,400,000 annual revenue, contribution after opex €840,000 per year.
The one-time scale-entry investment of €400,000 is shown separately and is not netted against any per-year figure.
Every scenario depends on the adoption assumption; the base case needs 20% adoption of the reachable pool.

unknowns: Cash flow and payback: ramp, retention, cash timing, partner margin and FX policy are not in the model
